title: The Golden Legion
summary: Old Aurel, a retired soldier of the Ashford Watch, heard you are hunting in the Nether. He fought piglins in his youth and has a story about a warrior of theirs who could not die. Go and hear it.

quest_book.title: The Golden Legion
quest_book.author: Old Aurel
pages:
They tell me you are hunting wither skulls in the Nether. So did I, once, and I found something worse.

Come and see an old soldier. I have a story nobody believes.
- Aurel, late of the Ashford Watch

threats.name: Old Aurel
threats.target_line: Sit, sit. My knees don't do standing any more.
talk: You've been in the Nether. Then you've seen the bastions, and what piglins worship: gold.
Their army, long ago. Their champion was the Unbreakable. A furnace for a heart.
He sleeps in a golden tomb in an arena in the Nether wastes. Only netherite wakes him.
Because the cult wants his furnace-heart to forge the Wither a crown. Get to him first.
Because I tried, forty years ago, and ran. Someone should finish it.
